Theorem
[classification at diameter at least $\pi /2$]

Source: petersen:page-0474 1. ch12:12.3.4If $(M,g)$ is closed with $\sec \ge 1$ and $\mathrm{diam}\ge \pi /2$, then one of the following holds:

  1. $M$ is homeomorphic to a sphere;

  2. $M$ is isometric to a finite quotient $S^n(1)/\Gamma $ with $\Gamma $ acting reducibly (an invariant subspace exists);

  3. $M$ is isometric to $\mathbb {CP}^m$, $\mathbb {HP}^m$, or $\mathbb {CP}^m/\mathbb {Z}_2$ for $m$ odd;

  4. $M$ is isometric to $\mathbb {OP}^2$.
